name: Moses And Pharaoh
overview: The narrative of Moses and Pharaoh reveals God's sovereign power in accomplishing His redemptive purposes despite human resistance. God commands Moses to perform miraculous signs before Pharaoh to compel him to release God's people, while simultaneously hardening Pharaoh's heart to demonstrate His authority and justice. This tension highlights God's strength against prideful opposition, as He scatters the proud in their imaginations, ultimately fulfilling His plan to deliver His people for His glory.
